video_title: Knicks are SOFT??? Boogie & Lou GET HEATED Over Brunson-Wemby Shove!

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's usage rate is hurting the Knicks' best offensive flow
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson has the ball in his hand, the usage rate is going through Jalen Brunson
quotes.quote: It is on Jalen Brunson. Jalen Brunson has the ball in his hand, the usage rate is going through Jalen Brunson, especially in the fourth quarter. That is not their best offense. Their best offense is the first three quarters where they play through Karl-Anthony Towns, allow him to playmake, allow him to attack. I have never seen a guy challenge and try and go past Wemby as easy as I have seen Karl-Anthony Towns do in the first three quarters of these first three games. Why would they go away from that?

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson needs to be more efficient by moving the ball
quotes.excerpt: You have to get the ball moving side to side and not just so much pounding
quotes.quote: I still want Jalen Brunson to be an aggressive basketball player in the fourth quarter. He is that closer. If you want him to be efficient, I agree with what Chandler just said. You have to get the ball moving side to side and not just so much pounding the basketball, playing one-on-one and hoping just to make shots. Right now they are living and dying with him making or missing shots. He has not been his most efficient. It showed its head in Game 3.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins questions who on the Knicks will target Wemby
quotes.excerpt: Somebody needs to go out and handle it. My question is who?

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: I saw the quotes as well. I saw what Stefan Marbury said, somebody needs to go out and handle it. My question is who? Who on the Knicks is going to do it?

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: Huck Porty? Put a little Huck Porty in there for a couple minutes.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: I am not too convinced. I think they have a couple guys that will do it. Now, I do not know if these guys are going to have the impact that he wanted to have, but they have a couple guys that will do it.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams argues small guards get away with physical play
quotes.excerpt: The small guards when it comes to switching on the bigs get away with so much

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: I have said it time and time again. The small guards when it comes to switching on the bigs get away with so much.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: That is not what is happening in that play though.

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: In that play, but it could have been a build up. It could be a build up. They have been hitting on the kid since Game 1. It is a build up.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams defends the physicality as part of playoff basketball
quotes.excerpt: At some point we have to call a spade a spade. He is starting to have a history
quotes.quote: At some point we have to call a spade a spade. He is starting to have a history of this stuff. Now whether he is protecting himself or he is hitting first, I am with it, but that does not negate the fact that he is doing it. That is all I am saying. I am with it. If he is if he is if he is in a mindset saying I know these teams are going to play me physical, I am going to hit first, I am okay with that.
